cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Laboratory (Research) Technician to join our team. The role involves working in experimental animal model systems to understand genetic and molecular mechanisms regulating sex differences in melanocyte function and melanoma progression. The person hired will carry out experiments in melanocyte and melanoma cell lines and in mouse models of melanoma through a combination of independent and team-driven projects, and should be able to independently handle experiments or small research projects.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Primary responsibilities include but will not be limited to:
Maintaining, collecting, and preparing records of data as well as results for presentations, papers, etc.
Performing data analysis using statistical software packages
Applying molecular and cell biology approaches to cell lines and animal studies, including immunostaining, microscopy, flow cytometry, epigenetic assays, Crispr/Cas strategies, among others
Designing gene knockout/knockdown experiments, qPCRs, among others
Maintaining a mouse colony, contributing experimentally to ongoing research projects
Maintaining laboratory bacterial culture stocks, mammalian cell culture stocks, DNA Plasmid stocks
Training students in research methods and procedures as needed
Ordering supplies, writing and submitting protocols, and maintaining records of required training for all lab members
Performing other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
A Bachelor's Degree and at least 2 years of experience
Previous experience and proficiency in mouse husbandry, PCR-based genotyping, cell culture, flow cytometry, as well as DNA, RNA, and protein isolation and detection techniques
Working knowledge of general principles in genetics and molecular biology
Accurate and timely record keeping, impeccable organization, and demonstrated interest in working in a laboratory setting
Preferred Requirements
Skill sets in molecular cloning, cell culture, western blotting, and PCR
Excellence in standard molecular biology techniques and assays

You will regularly carry out experiments in melanocyte and melanoma cell lines and in mouse models of melanoma, contributing to both independent and team-driven projects, and staying in close contact with colleagues across ongoing research efforts.
cond_0051.responsibilities:
Primary responsibilities include but will not be limited to:
Maintaining, collecting, and preparing records of data as well as results for presentations, papers, etc.
Performing data analysis using statistical software packages
Applying molecular and cell biology approaches to cell lines and animal studies, including immunostaining, microscopy, flow cytometry, epigenetic assays, Crispr/Cas strategies, among others
Designing gene knockout/knockdown experiments, qPCRs, among others
Maintaining a mouse colony, contributing experimentally to ongoing research projects
Maintaining laboratory bacterial culture stocks, mammalian cell culture stocks, DNA Plasmid stocks
Training students in research methods and procedures as needed, actively communicating expectations and walking them through procedures
Ordering supplies, writing and submitting protocols, and maintaining records of required training for all lab members
Performing other duties as assigned.
cond_0051.requirements:
Previous experience and proficiency in mouse husbandry, PCR-based genotyping, cell culture, flow cytometry, as well as DNA, RNA, and protein isolation and detection techniques
Skill sets in molecular cloning, cell culture, western blotting, and PCR
Excellence in standard molecular biology techniques and assays
A Bachelor's Degree and at least 2 years of experience
Working knowledge of general principles in genetics and molecular biology
Accurate and timely record keeping, impeccable organization, and demonstrated interest in working in a laboratory setting

The person will mainly carry out experiments in melanocyte and melanoma cell lines and in mouse models of melanoma through a combination of independent and team driven projects. This individual should be able to independently handle experiments or small research projects.
cond_0136.responsibilities:
Primary responsibilities include but will not be limited to:
Maintaining, collecting, and preparing records of data as well as results for presentations, papers, etc.
Performing data analysis using statistical software packages
Applying molecular and cell biology approaches to cell lines and animal studies, including immunostaining, microscopy, flow cytometry, epigenetic assays, Crispr/Cas strategies, among others
Designing gene knockout/knockdown experiments, qPCRs, among others
Maintaining a mouse colony, contributing experimentally to ongoing research projects
Maintaining laboratory bacterial culture stocks, mammalian cell culture stocks, DNA Plasmid stocks
Training students in research methods and procedures as needed
Ordering supplies, writing and submitting protocols, and maintaining records of required training for all lab members
Performing other duties as assigned.
cond_0136.requirements:
Previous experience and proficiency in mouse husbandry, PCR-based genotyping, cell culture, flow cytometry, as well as DNA, RNA, and protein isolation and detection techniques
Skill sets in molecular cloning, cell culture, western blotting, and PCR
Excellence in standard molecular biology techniques and assays
A Bachelor's Degree and at least 2 years of experience
Working knowledge of general principles in genetics and molecular biology
Accurate and timely record keeping, impeccable organization, and demonstrated interest in working in a laboratory setting

The position will mainly carry out experiments in melanocyte and melanoma cell lines and in mouse models of melanoma through a combination of independent and team driven projects. This individual should be able to independently handle experiments or small research projects.
cond_0263.responsibilities:
Primary responsibilities include but will not be limited to:
Maintaining, collecting, and preparing records of data as well as results for presentations, papers, etc.
Performing data analysis using statistical software packages
Applying molecular and cell biology approaches to cell lines and animal studies, including immunostaining, microscopy, flow cytometry, epigenetic assays, Crispr/Cas strategies, among others
Designing gene knockout/knockdown experiments, qPCRs, among others
Maintaining a mouse colony, contributing experimentally to ongoing research projects
Maintaining laboratory bacterial culture stocks, mammalian cell culture stocks, DNA Plasmid stocks
Training students in research methods and procedures as needed
Ordering supplies, writing and submitting protocols, and maintaining records of required training for all lab members
Performing other duties as assigned.
cond_0263.requirements:
Demonstrated expertise in mouse husbandry, PCR-based genotyping, cell culture, flow cytometry, as well as DNA, RNA, and protein isolation and detection techniques
Deep knowledge of molecular cloning, cell culture, western blotting, and PCR
Advanced proficiency in standard molecular biology techniques and assays
Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred, with a minimum of 2 years of demonstrated hands-on laboratory experience
Strong command of general principles in genetics and molecular biology
Exceptional organizational skills, meticulous record keeping, and a proven track record of working effectively in a laboratory setting
cond_0263.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0263.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.

Accurate and timely record keeping, impeccable organization, and demonstrated interest in working in a laboratory setting

cond_0290.intro: We are looking for a Laboratory (Research) Technician to join our team. The role sits within a new laboratory and involves experimental animal model systems aimed at understanding genetic and molecular mechanisms regulating sex differences in melanocyte function and melanoma progression. The person hired will mainly carry out experiments in melanocyte and melanoma cell lines and in mouse models of melanoma through a combination of independent and team-driven projects. This individual should be able to independently handle experiments or small research projects.
cond_0290.responsibilities:
Primary responsibilities include but will not be limited to:
Maintaining, collecting, and preparing records of data as well as results for presentations, papers, etc.
Performing data analysis using statistical software packages
Applying molecular and cell biology approaches to cell lines and animal studies, including immunostaining, microscopy, flow cytometry, epigenetic assays, Crispr/Cas strategies, among others
Designing gene knockout/knockdown experiments, qPCRs, among others
Maintaining a mouse colony, contributing experimentally to ongoing research projects
Maintaining laboratory bacterial culture stocks, mammalian cell culture stocks, DNA Plasmid stocks
Training students in research methods and procedures as needed
Ordering supplies, writing and submitting protocols, and maintaining records of required training for all lab members
Performing other duties as assigned.
cond_0290.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in mouse husbandry, PCR-based genotyping, cell culture, flow cytometry, and DNA, RNA, and protein isolation and detection techniques
Deep knowledge of standard molecular biology techniques and assays, with a proven track record of executing them accurately
Advanced knowledge of general principles in genetics and molecular biology
Preferred Requirements
Strong command of molecular cloning, western blotting, and PCR
Exceptional organizational skills, meticulous record keeping, and a demonstrated commitment to working in a laboratory setting

You will execute experiments in melanocyte and melanoma cell lines and in mouse models of melanoma, driving both independent and team-based projects. This role requires someone who can take ownership of experiments and small research projects from start to finish.
cond_0305.responsibilities:
Primary responsibilities include but will not be limited to:
Maintaining, collecting, and preparing records of data as well as results for presentations, papers, etc.
Performing data analysis using statistical software packages
Applying molecular and cell biology approaches to cell lines and animal studies, including immunostaining, microscopy, flow cytometry, epigenetic assays, Crispr/Cas strategies, among others
Designing gene knockout/knockdown experiments, qPCRs, among others
Maintaining a mouse colony, contributing experimentally to ongoing research projects
Maintaining laboratory bacterial culture stocks, mammalian cell culture stocks, DNA Plasmid stocks
Training students in research methods and procedures as needed
Ordering supplies, writing and submitting protocols, and maintaining records of required training for all lab members
Performing other duties as assigned.
cond_0305.requirements:
Previous experience and proficiency in mouse husbandry, PCR-based genotyping, cell culture, flow cytometry, as well as DNA, RNA, and protein isolation and detection techniques
Skill sets in molecular cloning, cell culture, western blotting, and PCR
Excellence in standard molecular biology techniques and assays
A Bachelor's Degree and at least 2 years of experience
Working knowledge of general principles in genetics and molecular biology
Accurate and timely record keeping, impeccable organization, and demonstrated interest in working in a laboratory setting

You will regularly carry out experiments in melanocyte and melanoma cell lines and in mouse models of melanoma, contributing to both independent and team-driven projects, and staying in close contact with colleagues across ongoing research efforts.
cond_0321.responsibilities:
Primary responsibilities include but will not be limited to:
Maintaining, collecting, and preparing records of data as well as results for presentations, papers, etc.
Performing data analysis using statistical software packages
Applying molecular and cell biology approaches to cell lines and animal studies, including immunostaining, microscopy, flow cytometry, epigenetic assays, Crispr/Cas strategies, among others
Designing gene knockout/knockdown experiments, qPCRs, among others
Maintaining a mouse colony, contributing experimentally to ongoing research projects
Maintaining laboratory bacterial culture stocks, mammalian cell culture stocks, DNA Plasmid stocks
Training students in research methods and procedures as needed, actively communicating expectations and walking them through procedures
Ordering supplies, writing and submitting protocols, and maintaining records of required training for all lab members
Performing other duties as assigned.
cond_0321.requirements:
Previous experience and proficiency in mouse husbandry, PCR-based genotyping, cell culture, flow cytometry, as well as DNA, RNA, and protein isolation and detection techniques
Skill sets in molecular cloning, cell culture, western blotting, and PCR
Excellence in standard molecular biology techniques and assays
A Bachelor's Degree and at least 2 years of experience
Working knowledge of general principles in genetics and molecular biology
Accurate and timely record keeping, impeccable organization, and demonstrated interest in working in a laboratory setting
cond_0321.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.
cond_0321.workplace_support: We foster connection and community through employee groups and inclusive workplace initiatives so people can bring their full selves to work and find support across different identities and life experiences.

cond_0362.intro: We are looking for a Laboratory (Research) Technician to join our team. The role sits within a new laboratory and involves experimental animal model systems aimed at understanding genetic and molecular mechanisms regulating sex differences in melanocyte function and melanoma progression. The person hired will mainly carry out experiments in melanocyte and melanoma cell lines and in mouse models of melanoma through a combination of independent and team-driven projects. This individual should be able to independently handle experiments or small research projects.
cond_0362.responsibilities:
Primary responsibilities include but will not be limited to:
Maintaining, collecting, and preparing records of data as well as results for presentations, papers, etc.
Performing data analysis using statistical software packages
Applying molecular and cell biology approaches to cell lines and animal studies, including immunostaining, microscopy, flow cytometry, epigenetic assays, Crispr/Cas strategies, among others
Designing gene knockout/knockdown experiments, qPCRs, among others
Maintaining a mouse colony, contributing experimentally to ongoing research projects
Maintaining laboratory bacterial culture stocks, mammalian cell culture stocks, DNA Plasmid stocks
Training students in research methods and procedures as needed
Ordering supplies, writing and submitting protocols, and maintaining records of required training for all lab members
Performing other duties as assigned.
cond_0362.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in mouse husbandry, PCR-based genotyping, cell culture, flow cytometry, and DNA, RNA, and protein isolation and detection techniques
Deep knowledge of standard molecular biology techniques and assays, with a proven track record of executing them accurately
Advanced knowledge of general principles in genetics and molecular biology
Preferred Requirements
Strong command of molecular cloning, western blotting, and PCR
Exceptional organizational skills, meticulous record keeping, and a demonstrated commitment to working in a laboratory setting
